breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The agent repeated the error from the incomplete prompt. It kept the parallel-flow LMTD expression and the parallel-flow temperature differences (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,in and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,out) instead of correcting them to the counterflow definitions (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in) as required by the ground truth.
